title: Introduce econ-prefetch-adapter and quant-profile-factory for tenant-aware warmup
author: Priya Menon
description:
Motivation: On several mid-size tenant workloads we observed repeated cold-KV-cache penalties and suboptimal token-unit economics when a single conservative quant profile was applied cluster-wide. This PR introduces two coordinated components: (1) econ-prefetch-adapter — a lightweight runtime adapter that makes tenant-scoped warmup/prefetch decisions based on short-term traffic signals and budget constraints, and (2) quant-profile-factory — a server-side component that emits candidate quantization presets per model x workload signature, with safety bands and rollback markers.

High-level design: econ-prefetch-adapter runs in the serving path as a non-blocking hint generator. It tracks recent sequence-length distribution, request affinity, and monetary budget windows (per-tenant soft budget) and decides a small number of warmup prefetchs (KV or prefix) and micro-batching hints. quant-profile-factory consumes profiling traces (sampled replay) and produces ranked quant presets (fp16/4-bit/bitsandbytes mixes) keyed by model name, max_seq, and workload signature. The factory attaches conservative degradation metrics and an automated scoring metric (approx_unit_econ) used by the adapter to pick profiles at runtime.

Changes included: single continuous PR description with checklist, commits and file lists below. Implementation highlights: - New runtime package: services/econ_prefetch_adapter with a pluggable policy interface and a small in-memory budget ledger. - New control plane service: tools/quant_profile_factory that runs as a batch job and exposes a REST preview endpoint for generated presets. - Safety gate: rollout policy that requires both unit-econ score >= baseline and two-stage shadow validation (10k requests shadow then 24h pilot). - Telemetry: new metrics (econ.prefetch.hits, econ.prefetch.cost_saved, quant.profile.score_delta) and tracing tags for experiment correlation.

Checklist: [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-642) [x] unit tests for adapter policy and budget accounting [x] e2e shadow validation harness [x] telemetry dashboards skeleton [x] opt-out switch for tenants and global feature flag

Testing & results: Ran tenant-targeted canary for 7 tenants over 48 hours. Observed median token-cost reduction of 11.8% and 95th percentile latency impact within +3% (under the configured safety band). Two minor regressions discovered (one for extremely bursty small-requests tenant) and mitigated by tightening per-tenant warmup budget caps.

Rollout plan: feature-flagged rollout via Console: preview -> shadow -> pilot -> enable. Admin endpoint added to list generated quant profiles and force-rollback.

Notes: This PR intentionally avoids aggressive global auto-quantization; the factory produces candidate presets and leaves selection to the adapter with explicit safety checks. The approach is designed to be conservative by default but enable per-tenant unit-econ gains without operator intervention.
